packet.claim: The test campaign expects recover_json_object to move to the object after the closing fence when a fence already contains an object, but the documented rule says the last object inside a code fence wins when any fence holds one.
packet.expected: The recovered object remains {"a":1} because the fence holds an object and it is the last one inside a code fence.
packet.scope: inputs where a code fence contains a JSON object and another JSON object is added after the closing fence
packet.source_basis: The object scored is the last one inside a code fence when any fence holds one, else the last top-level object in the text
